Working:

1. Thermodynamic / physical data  
   Rspec = R/M = 8314 / 16.04 = 5.183×10²  J kg⁻¹ K⁻¹  
   ε/D = 0.046 mm / 0.30 m = 1.53×10⁻⁴  
   A = πD²/4 = 0.070686 m²  
   ln(P₁/P₂) = ln(5/3) = 0.5108  

2. Isothermal‐flow momentum integral (including kinetic–energy term)

        fL/D = (P₁² – P₂²)/( G² Rspec T ) – 2 ln(P₁/P₂)

   (P₁²–P₂²)=1.6×10¹³ Pa² ,  Rspec T = 1.4927×10⁵ J kg⁻¹  
   ⇒ C ≡ (P₁²–P₂²)/(Rspec T)=1.073×10⁸ (kg m⁻³)

        G² = C / (1.3333×10⁵ f + 1.0216)

3. Iteration with Colebrook for f (Re = G D/μ, μ =1.1×10⁻⁵ Pa·s)

   Start f=0.02 → G=201 → Re≈5.5×10⁶ → update f with Colebrook.  
   Converged values:

        f = 0.0132
        G = 2.47×10² kg m⁻² s⁻¹
        Re = 6.7×10⁶  (constant along pipe)

4. Mass flow rate

        ṁ = G A = 246.6 kg m⁻² s⁻¹ × 0.070686 m² = 17.4 kg s⁻¹

5. Outlet velocity

        ρ₂ = P₂ /(Rspec T)=3.0×10⁶ /1.4927×10⁵ = 20.1 kg m⁻³
        V₂ = G/ρ₂ = 246.6 / 20.1 = 12.3 m s⁻¹

FINAL (a): 17.4 kg/s  
FINAL (b): 6.7×10⁶ (dimensionless)  
FINAL (c): 0.0132 (dimensionless)  
FINAL (d): 12.3 m/s
